_staff: People of the team who write no code (testers, product owners). The redaction of personal data (R-02) keeps every git author and Jira user readable, and these names too; any other 'Name Surname' in ticket text is masked before a model reads it. Check with: node agent/redaction-audit.mjs --project <KEY>.
_presentation: Shown on the first and the last slide of the presentation (?present, ?deck): who presents, the team, a contact. An empty value is left out.
_baseline: Impact (WF5): the minutes each step takes the team WITHOUT the agent. Team estimates, not measurements, and the Impact tab says so. Hours saved = these minus the measured time, for a ticket's first analysis in a week, merged fixes and merged documentation.

insights._components: Hotspot map: a file belongs to the first component with a matching path prefix (tests count with their main code: src/test/java is read as src/main/java). Files outside every component are not counted.

_projects: One entry per Jira project and application repository; one watcher and one dashboard for all. A project entry overrides the settings above (insights, backendTestDir, …). stateDir: the project's agent state (default state/projects/<KEY>). app: ports of the running app (demo/run-mediagenda.mjs --project <KEY>). linked: the projects whose APIs the app calls; their code (read-only) and Jira tickets are part of every analysis. A project without a clone at repo is not watched.

relations.DEM: patients (age, sex) from the MediAgenda registry
relations.LAB: the patient's latest creatinine from MediLab (GET /api/patients/{fiscalCode}/results) for the renal dose check

askExamples: How is the renal dose check computed?
Which bugs did Erogazione have, and why?
Why can an expired lot not be dispensed?

projects.name: MediBill
projects.description: Billing: charges imported from MediAgenda visits and MediLab tests, co-pay and exemptions, receipts

relations.DEM: visits to charge: MediAgenda bookings (GET /api/bookings) and patients
relations.LAB: tests to charge: reported MediLab requests (GET /api/orders?status=REFERTATA)

askExamples: How is the co-pay (ticket) of a receipt computed?
Which bugs did the charge import have, and why?
Why is a receipt with an exemption 0 €?
Who knows the MediAgenda import best?

projects.name: MediVax
projects.description: Vaccination centre (pilot): patients, vaccine catalog and lots, doses, next doses due. Synthetic patients; new tickets every working day (docs/PILOT.md)
askExamples: When is the next dose of a series due?
Until which day can a lot be used?
Which bugs did the patient search have, and why?
Who knows the dose rules best?
projects._pilot: The pilot (demo/pilot.mjs tick, every 30 min): on working days, perDay changes with a hidden bug are pushed to main at the given hours, and the bug is reported in Jira reportAfterMinutes later. Scores against the answer key: node demo/pilot.mjs status.
